profile_text.body:
# IBM

IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. As of 2025, IBM reported revenue of $67.535 billion. The company offers AI-powered governance, risk management, and compliance solutions across its product portfolio.

IBM describes OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution. The platform features the OpenPages GRC Canvas, an interactive workspace for modeling processes, risks, and controls with live data. IBM states that the platform embeds AI to automate classification and issue creation, and can integrate watsonx.ai or preferred third-party AI models through an API-based architecture. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment. OpenPages includes an MCP Server to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects.

IBM's AI governance offerings also include watsonx.governance, an AI lifecycle governance platform that provides model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation capabilities with EU AI Act accelerators. Gartner named IBM watsonx.governance a Leader in its first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM's broader watsonx enterprise AI platform incorporates governance features for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection across model-agnostic deployments. The company has 342 legal matters pending in New York.
